newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU reviews Dutch PTT buy of TNT.
newsitem.headline: EU reviews Dutch PTT buy of TNT.

text.p: The European Commission said on Monday it was reviewing the proposed takeover of Australian transport group TNT Ltd by Dutch PTT Post BV.
The takeover bid also concerns the two companies' joint venture GD Express Worldwide (GDEW), an international courier firm also active in express parcel and remail activities.

The Commission said in a statement to be published in the European Union's Official Journal that the operation apparently fell under the bloc's merger rules which ban creation or strengthening of dominant positions.
PTT Post BV is the postal and logistics subsidiary of Koninklijke PTT Nederland NV (KPN).
Dutch PTT said on October 2 that it would pay A$2.45 per ordinary share for TNT in a deal valuing the Australian company at about A$2.0 billion.

The deal was submitted for EU clearance on October 4. The Commission has until the beginning of November to approve the acquisition or start an in-depth four-month inquiry if worried about its effect on competition in the Union.
